items.title: Awesome Zsh Plugins
items.content_text:
### Plugins / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [aws-login (⭐0)](https://github.com/mithredate/zsh-aws-login) - Provides an `aws-login` command that starts an AWS session that only the current terminal and its child processes can use.
*   [claude-sandbox (⭐4)](https://github.com/LordMauldascha/claude-sandbox) - Points `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` at a throwaway directory, so everything Claude Code reads and writes (settings, plugins, skills, history, credentials) stays inside that sandbox. Leave it, delete it, and your real setup is exactly as you left it.
*   [curl-edit (⭐0)](https://github.com/AndrewHany/zsh-curl-edit) - Automatically open pasted cURL commands in an editor before executing them.
*   [sf-shortcuts (⭐1)](https://github.com/hggaguilera/sf-shortcuts) - Short, predictable commands for the Salesforce CLI (`sf`), with tab completion for Apex classes, components (aura/lightning) and orgs.
*   [SparkleBIOS (⭐3)](https://github.com/reactivepixels/sparklebios) - Draws a retro 1995 PC BIOS boot screen with real system facts and cached health checks when a new ZSH session starts.
*   [tab-start (⭐0)](https://github.com/arnodirlam/tab-start) - adds starter entries to ZSH completion when you press `TAB` at a blank prompt. Uses [fzf-tab (⭐5k)](https://github.com/Aloxaf/fzf-tab) to render those entries and provides grouping, fuzzy search, and selection.
*   [tmux-inside (⭐0)](https://github.com/hgarfer/ohmyzsh-tmux-inside) - A drop-in replacement for the [oh-my-zsh](https://ohmyz.sh/) `tmux` plugin that makes the [tmux](https://tmux.app) aliases work from inside a `tmux` session: instead of trying to nest a session (which `tmux` refuses), they switch to the target session, creating it detached in the current directory if needed.
*   [utm (⭐0)](https://github.com/zsh-contrib/zsh-utm) - Adds a single `utm` command on top of `utmctl`, the command line tool that ships with [UTM](https://mac.getutm.app/), with tab completion for subcommands, virtual machine names and snapshot names, and a --wait that utmctl does not have.

Plugins / superconsole - Windows-only

  • aws-login (⭐0) - Provides an aws-login command that starts an AWS session that only the current terminal and its child processes can use.
  • claude-sandbox (⭐4) - Points CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR at a throwaway directory, so everything Claude Code reads and writes (settings, plugins, skills, history, credentials) stays inside that sandbox. Leave it, delete it, and your real setup is exactly as you left it.
  • curl-edit (⭐0) - Automatically open pasted cURL commands in an editor before executing them.
  • sf-shortcuts (⭐1) - Short, predictable commands for the Salesforce CLI (sf), with tab completion for Apex classes, components (aura/lightning) and orgs.
  • SparkleBIOS (⭐3) - Draws a retro 1995 PC BIOS boot screen with real system facts and cached health checks when a new ZSH session starts.
  • tab-start (⭐0) - adds starter entries to ZSH completion when you press TAB at a blank prompt. Uses fzf-tab (⭐5k) to render those entries and provides grouping, fuzzy search, and selection.
  • tmux-inside (⭐0) - A drop-in replacement for the oh-my-zsh tmux plugin that makes the tmux aliases work from inside a tmux session: instead of trying to nest a session (which tmux refuses), they switch to the target session, creating it detached in the current directory if needed.
  • utm (⭐0) - Adds a single utm command on top of utmctl, the command line tool that ships with UTM, with tab completion for subcommands, virtual machine names and snapshot names, and a --wait that utmctl does not have.

items.title: Awesome Mac
items.content_text:
### Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

*   [Swamp Converter (⭐3)](https://github.com/aansonsa/swamp-converter) - Menu bar file converter: drag a file, tap a key and drop it on a wheel to convert video, audio, images and PDFs. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/aansonsa/swamp-converter) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")
*   [Tarn (⭐0)](https://github.com/jakeantelis/Tarn) - A calm menu bar app for focused work rounds and slow breathing, with optional ambient sounds. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/jakeantelis/Tarn) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Utilities / Cleanup and Uninstall

*   [Burrow (⭐6)](https://github.com/khan-umirzakoff/Mole-GUI) - Free, open-source native app for the Mole cleaner: clean caches, uninstall apps and the leftovers of deleted ones, map the disk and watch system health, all through Mole's safety checks. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/khan-umirzakoff/Mole-GUI) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

### Utilities / Window Management

*   [Flickbar](https://flickbar.github.io/) - Open-source window manager driven by trackpad gestures on window title bars. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/flickbar/flickbar) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Remote Login Software / System Related Tools

*   [Glass](https://glassdesk.dev) - Low-latency remote desktop for Mac and Linux that you view from any browser, with nothing to install on the viewing device. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/Ntarasiuk/glass) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")
